description: Find help articles by keyword, title or text. Exact keywords rank first, then title and keyword-prefix matches, then hits in the article text. A leading facet word narrows the search like in game: "spell fire", "skill sword", "race elf", "class", "command", "zone", "religion", "clan" (RU/UA forms work too). Returns ids for help_get.

lang.description: Answer language: en, ru or ua (uk also accepted). Untranslated text falls back to Russian.

query.description: What to look for, in any of the three languages.

name: help_search
title: Search DreamLand help
